segments.text: The night my daughter disappeared, the world turned to ash.
segments.text_zh: 女儿失踪的那个夜晚，世界化为了灰烬。

segments.text: They said it was an accident. A fire. No survivors.
segments.text_zh: 他们说那是一场意外。一场火灾。无人生还。

segments.text: But I knew the truth. I saw them - the shadows with burning eyes.
segments.text_zh: 但我知道真相。我看见了它们——那些眼中燃烧着火焰的暗影。

segments.text: Demons. They took her soul to Hell.
segments.text_zh: 恶魔。它们把她的灵魂带去了地狱。

segments.text: I searched for years. Studied forbidden texts. Made terrible bargains.
segments.text_zh: 我寻找了很多年。研读禁忌典籍。做出可怕的交易。

segments.text: Until finally, I found a way. A door to the underworld.
segments.text_zh: 直到最终，我找到了方法。一扇通往冥界的门。

segments.text: Lucifer himself awaited me. He offered a deal.
segments.text_zh: 路西法本人在等着我。他提出了一个交易。

segments.text: "Find the demon who took your daughter. Prove your worth as an Arbiter."
"Judge the souls of the damned. If all the good survive... she goes free."
I accepted. What choice did I have?
segments.text_zh: 我接受了。我还有什么选择呢？

segments.text: Now I descend into Hell. To become the Arbiter.
segments.text_zh: 现在我将降入地狱。成为仲裁者。

segments.text: To bring my daughter home.
segments.text_zh: 为了把我的女儿带回家。

segments.text: The gates of Hell opened before me.
segments.text_zh: 地狱之门在我面前打开。

segments.text: And there she was. My daughter. Waiting.
segments.text_zh: 她就在那里。我的女儿。在等待。

segments.text: We walked out of the darkness together.
Back to the light. Back home.
I failed. The good souls perished in flames.
segments.text_zh: 我失败了。善良的灵魂在火焰中消逝。

segments.text: Lucifer's laughter echoed through eternity.
segments.text_zh: 路西法的笑声在永恒中回荡。

segments.text: My daughter remains trapped. Forever.
segments.text_zh: 我的女儿永远被困在那里。

segments.text: And I... I stay to try again.
segments.text_zh: 而我...我留下来，再次尝试。
